scan-before-edit.rule: process ask "Was the existing UI scanned before any edit was made?"

read-design-context.rule: process ask "Were the existing design tokens, fonts, framework and design context read before designing?"
process ask "Does new code match the naming and export conventions of neighboring components?"
process ask "Was a real reference obtained from the user and matched?"

measure-with-tools.rule: process ask "Was the result verified with measurements rather than intuition?"

screenshot-verify.rule: process ask "Was the result verified with rendered evidence (screenshots or browser inspection) rather than assumed?"
process ask "Was the result checked at desktop, tablet and mobile viewports?"

one-change-at-a-time.rule: process ask "Are changes small, targeted and limited to the named target rather than rewrites?"

generate-extraction-oriented-images-per-.rule: process ask "Is each section generated as its own large, readable image rather than crops of a larger image?"

keep-design-language-consistent-across-d.rule: process ask "Do all generated images and screens keep one design language (palette, typography, buttons, radius, image treatment)?"

analyze-reference-image-deeply-before-im.rule: process ask "Was the reference image analyzed in depth (typography, text, buttons, components) before implementation?"

generate-one-image-per-section.rule: process ask "Is there exactly one horizontal image per section, with the image count equal to the section count?"

generate-reference-image-before-coding.rule: process ask "Was a reference design image generated and analyzed before coding began?"

preserve-reference-design-fidelity-in-co.rule: page ask "Does the coded result keep the look, spacing and typography of the reference design rather than a generic layout?"

force-divergence-by-mechanism-not-prompt.rule: process ask "Was divergence from the default idea forced by a mechanism (such as picking a later candidate) rather than by asking to be original?"

randomize-layout-choices-from-a-seed.rule: process ask "Were layout choices selected by a deterministic seeded randomization rather than defaulting to the first option?"

write-design-plan-before-code.rule: process ask "Was a design plan written and verified before any UI code?"

refine-past-the-first-render.rule: process ask "Was the design refined past the first render until it felt clean and consistent?"

state-inferred-audience-and-tone-assumpt.rule: process ask "Were the inferred audience, use and tone stated at the top of the reply?"

check-layout-skeleton-not-only-surface.rule: page ask "Does the layout skeleton differ from the category default template, not only the surface styling?"

vary-layout-and-aesthetic-between-genera.rule: process ask "Does the layout and aesthetic differ from the previous generation?"

infer-design-direction-from-the-brief.rule: process ask "Was the design direction inferred from the brief before code was touched?"

generate-section-specific-imagery-assets.rule: process ask "Were section-specific image assets generated with an available image tool rather than hand-rolled CSS?"

plan-layout-with-wireframes-and-alignmen.rule: process ask "Was the layout planned with wireframes and alignment guidance before building?"

skip-anti-gimmick-guards.rule: process ask "Was the design made without an anti-gimmick guard that caps the work?"

brief-with-commit-language-not-hedges.rule: process ask "Is the brief written with commit language rather than hedges and caveats?"

widen-references-beyond-product-category.rule: process ask "Were references widened beyond the product category when the brief was generic?"

break-default-layout-biases.rule: page ask "Does the layout avoid default LLM biases (narrow wrapped headings, empty bento gaps, cheap meta-labels)?"

avoid-unnecessary-follow-up-questions.rule: process ask "Were follow-up questions avoided where a strong interpretation was possible?"

inspect-page-in-both-color-modes.rule: page ask "Was the page inspected in both light and dark mode?"
